parts.text: Here is the whole journey in one picture. {email}It starts when Hillcrest School emails a quote request. {ai}The AI reads it and lays out the lines, {approve}a reviewer approves the quote, {qb}and the estimate goes to QuickBooks. {po}When the school's purchase order arrives, {compare}every line is checked against the quote, and one price is flagged. {vus}The order goes to Acme Supply, {ups}UPS ships it, {paid}the school pays, {closed}and the order is closed.

Behind every task is the intake engine. {inbox}Every few minutes it reads the sales and info mailboxes, {sort}sorts each email into a quote request, a purchase order, a supplier invoice or a remittance, {junk}and sets the rest aside. {scan}Then the AI reads the email that matters {fields}and pulls out the customer, the lines and the total, {task}and a task lands in the queue with a confidence score. {review}A person makes the call, {order}the approved task moves the order forward, {sync}and the order trades data with QuickBooks, UPS and Acme Supply.
